findings.classification: SOURCE-PRESENT pure kernel change; runtime integration REQUIRED
findings.fact: Commit-null, inherited checkpoint, supersession and nonpending state refuse before availability. Present availability checks item.source; false returns unavailable before evaluateGuard/revalidateAuthority/claim mint. Absent port performs no check. Available targets preserve guard then authority then claim. Tests use injected manual clock/IDs/supersession/availability and pin this pure order; no tests executed by this audit.
findings.impact: Every pending declared source sent through this function and a present port is gated, including capability operations and queue/event targets. Fanout child claim mechanism has no target and is untouched. Deployment-unknown is not unavailable and is not qualified available. Preserve actual callback/proxy order for each host, not only equal final status.
findings.gate: Qualify actual dispatcher availability adapter over the full selected operation/event domain and installed callbacks; do not infer universal implementation from optional port.

findings.fact: FenceAttemptDispatchFn dependency shape omits availability. runFenceGate supplies no availability, pulls current snapshot and awaits actual revalidateAuthority before invoking the pure kernel, whose revalidateAuthority replays the resolved boolean. driveDispatchIntent mints and persists a real work.dispatch.claim before this gate. Decoder accepts claimed/skipped/inherited/revoked only and throws on unavailable. Searches found no production availability adapter or non-test direct kernel caller beyond injected gate references.
findings.impact: Current drive does not enforce new availability; a future injected unavailable verdict reaches a loud decoder error, not terminal BusinessError. Kernel no-claim/no-authority-callback assertions are not actual drive claims or async callback order. A claimed row can be held and age out when gate throws; the new delta does not prove no-redrive.
findings.gate: Pin accepted host observable ordering with actual claim/fence/snapshot/authority/availability callbacks; qualified runtime mapping and durable terminal settlement/ack with no provider call, preserving genuine revocation/privacy semantics. No ordering architecture selected here.

Generated Send passes IR operation string to send helper. Activation map covers capability IDs and compatibility checks resource binding kind/logicalName, not this new operation-string port.

Preserve original source identity for receipts and deterministic IDs.
